problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: weight 51kg
* Shipment Beta: weight 46kg
* Shipment Gamma: weight 68kg
* Shipment Delta: weight 38kg
* Shipment Epsilon: weight 49kg
* Shipment Zeta: weight 32kg
* Shipment Eta: weight 42kg
* Shipment Theta: weight 63kg
* Shipment Iota: weight 48kg
* Shipment Kappa: weight 46kg
* Shipment Lambda: weight 45kg
* Shipment Mu: weight 35kg
* Shipment Nu: weight 59kg
* Shipment Xi: weight 37kg
* Shipment Omicron: weight 64kg
* Shipment Pi: weight 61kg
* Shipment Rho: weight 50kg
* Shipment Sigma: weight 41kg
* Shipment Tau: weight 49kg
* Shipment Upsilon: weight 62kg
* Shipment Phi: weight 36kg
* Shipment Chi: weight 30kg
* Shipment Psi: weight 43kg
* Shipment Omega: weight 44kg
* Shipment A1: weight 53kg
* Shipment B1: weight 64kg
* Shipment C1: weight 41kg
* Shipment D1: weight 53kg
* Shipment E1: weight 51kg
* Shipment F1: weight 44kg
* Shipment G1: weight 49kg
* Shipment H1: weight 42kg
* Shipment I1: weight 70kg
* Shipment J1: weight 62kg
* Shipment K1: weight 33kg
* Shipment L1: weight 54kg
* Shipment M1: weight 46kg
* Shipment N1: weight 48kg
* Shipment O1: weight 54kg

Each cargo plane can carry a maximum load of 100 kg. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Every shipment must be placed on exactly one plane, and the total weight loaded onto a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
